description: This source file defines the EntityObjectCache class, a cache implementation for entity objects within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages caching of entity-related objects based on conditions and names, providing methods to get, put, and remove cache entries.

classes.name: EntityObjectCache
classes.description: A cache class for storing entity objects based on entity name and conditions within OFBiz.

methods.name: EntityObjectCache
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache with a delegator name.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an object from the cache based on entity name, condition, and a name key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts an object into the cache associated with a specific entity, condition, and name key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an object from the cache based on entity name, condition, and name.
